notes:
• The scene bar always shows the scene you are on. Collapsed, or set to just the Scenes button, the bar hid every scene, the one you were on with them, so the GM could lose track of where they were. That scene now stays beside the Scenes button, marked as it is in the row when it is the active one, with its preview, its right-click menu, and a double-click to activate it. A long name is cut short. Open, the bar shows it in the row as before.
  • The Compendium Browser's tabs as a labeled row. The setting that lays the D&D 5e sheets' tabs in a row now does the same for the system's Compendium Browser: its tabs, which hung down the outside of the window as icons, lie in a row across the top of it, over the search and the results, each with its name. The basic set fits the browser at the size it opens at; narrower, the row scrolls, with the arrows the sheets have. The Advanced set is laid out the same way, and a browser opened for one kind of thing, which has no tabs, is left as it is. The browser's own background shows through the row, in either theme; in the light one the tabs are named in a darker shade of the system's gold, so they read on the paper. The setting is now called "D&D 5e tabs as a labeled row".
